start_here: Say to your AI: "Read this computer's load." It samples this computer's load, cores, memory pressure and top CPU process names, read-only, and gives back one line. Its workflow workflow:sample-this-computers-load runs it every five minutes.
no_lists_because: The samples are kept as computer_readings rows of the person's own database; no list of the person's is needed.
instructions: 1. Run the tool from the Workshop checkout: python3 -I tools/read-this-computers-load/do-work/read-load.py.
2. Read the one JSON line it prints: load_1m, cores, memory_pressure_free_pct and top_cpu_names.
3. To keep it every five minutes, switch on the wake of workflow:sample-this-computers-load with credential_name set to your database's vault name.

worked_examples.title: Read the load once
worked_examples.answer: One JSON line: read_at, host, cores, load_1m, memory_pressure_free_pct and top_cpu_names.
